description: This file contains the styling for a web-based Tic Tac Toe application, including theme management, layout properties, and responsive design rules.

classes.name: App
classes.description: The main application container for the Tic Tac Toe game, defining its overall layout and styles.

classes.name: ttt-game-container
classes.description: Container for the Tic Tac Toe game, providing styling for the layout and background.

classes.name: ttt-title
classes.description: Styles for the title of the Tic Tac Toe game, including font size and color.

classes.name: ttt-board
classes.description: Styling for the grid layout of the Tic Tac Toe board.

classes.name: ttt-cell
classes.description: Styles for individual cells of the Tic Tac Toe board.

classes.name: ttt-square
classes.description: Styling for each square of the Tic Tac Toe board, including hover and active states.

classes.name: ttt-controls
classes.description: Container for control buttons and status display.

classes.name: ttt-reset-btn
classes.description: Styles for the reset button that allows players to start a new game.

classes.name: theme-toggle
classes.description: Button for toggling between light and dark themes.
